Meet Aligned, Your AI Deal Workspace

Help Buyers Decide Faster

Give buyers one organized space for content, tasks, timelines, and next steps so decisions happen faster.

One link for the entire deal

Everything in one shared, buyer-friendly space; simple URL, no login required.

Streamlined buyer evaluation

Keep resources, questions, and next steps in one place; no email-file-link overwhelm or buyers out of the loop.

Always-on buyer AI guidance

AI answers buyer questions and guides buyers using only your shared deal content, surfaces hidden stakeholders and follow-up signals, and keeps momentum moving even when sellers are offline.

Equip Champions with AI-Built Content

Empower your internal advocates with AI-generated content that helps them sell to leadership.

AI-Built Workspaces

No more spending hours thinking of what to share; AI builds entire deal rooms in seconds.

AI-Built Narratives

Automatically creates clear, decision-ready stories: business cases, exec summaries, MAPs, POCs, onboarding plans — structured for how decisions actually get made.

Shareable in One Click

Champions forward a single link — no reformatting, no decks, no rewriting emails, no spreadsheets.

Consistent Messaging Across Stakeholders

Everyone sees the same source of truth, reducing internal confusion and strengthening the champion’s case.

Mutual Action Plans Built to Be Used

MAPs live where the deal runs — not ignored spreadsheets — driving real follow-through and momentum.

Reveal Hidden Signals & Stakeholders

See what your CRM alone can’t — by reading the full deal across calls, emails, calendar, CRM, and workspace buying activity.

Hidden stakeholder discovery

Instantly surface and map new decision-makers the moment they view, forward, or engage — no more blind email forwards.

Real buying signal tracking

See real intent through repeat pricing views, internal sharing, stalled steps, and engagement patterns — correlated with calls, email, and CRM.

AI-interpreted risks & opportunities

AI flags what’s off, explains why it matters, and surfaces deal gaps early with suggested next steps to keep momentum moving.

Guide Winning Execution

Turn insight into consistent action — without relying on rep guesswork.

AI-guided next best actions

AI reads calls, emails, CRM, and buyer activity together — then recommends what to do next, when it matters

Execution visible in the workspace

Follow-ups, recaps, MAP updates, and next steps visible to all — not across CRM notes, docs, and inboxes

Playbooks applied in real time

Your best practices appear directly in the workflow using pre-built templates

Predictable execution across every rep

Every deal runs like your top performer’s — consistent, buyer-first, and hard to stall.

Enablement That Actually Gets Used

Bridge the gap between sales and marketing with Enablement that lives inside the deal—not in a library.

Built-in CMS/LMS where deals run

Enablement shows up where it’s used—battlecards, ROI, security, mutual plans, and proof where buyers evaluate and reps execute—not buried in libraries.

Buyer-level analytics

See which assets actually close deals—engagement, internal sharing, stakeholder spread.

CS continuity

Deal context, commitments, and success criteria flow into onboarding
